title: Detroit Hot Honey Wings
description: These Detroit-inspired hot honey wings are packed with bold, finger-licking, sweet-spicy flavors. They'll be a hit at your next BBQ or game-day party.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper (add more if you can stand it)
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill to medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Pat wings dry with paper towels. Season wings with cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Cook chicken wings on the preheated grill, brushing wings liberally with 1/2 cup honey while cooking, until cooked through and juices run clear, 20 to 30 minutes.
Mix butter, hot sauce, and remaining 1/2 cup honey together in a large bowl.
Remove wings from the grill and immediately toss them in hot honey-butter sauce to coat. Serve wings or return to the grill for 1 minute per side to set sauce.

video.description: The perfect mix of spicy and sweet, you won't be able to get enough of these finger-licking Detroit Hot Honey Wings. Cayenne, salt and pepper makes the chicken spicy, then brush on honey as the chicken is cooking to get the hint of sweetness. Coat the chicken wings in hot sauce and butter for even more flavor and either eat them while they're "wet" or set them on the grill for another minute!
